hooks.command: jq -r '.session_id' | { read -r sid; mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks && touch "/tmp/claude-hooks/edits-${sid}.flag"; } 2>/dev/null || true

DATA=$(jq -r '[(.stop_hook_active // false | tostring), .session_id] | @tsv'); SHA=$(echo "$DATA" | cut -f1); SID=$(echo "$DATA" | cut -f2); FLAG="/tmp/claude-hooks/edits-${SID}.flag"; if [ "$SHA" = "true" ]; then rm -f "$FLAG"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$FLAG" ]; then exit 0; fi; rm "$FLAG"; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Before stopping: check whether the code changes you made this turn made any information in CLAUDE.md (at /Users/michaelcunningham/Desktop/general_coding/agentic_transaction_categorizer/CLAUDE.md) obsolete; if so, update it to reflect reality, keeping it under 200 lines (warn the user if it exceeds 150). If the file is still accurate, briefly say so and stop."}'
